say:1:1621738001:1.text: S-Sorry! We didn't mean to snoop... We were looking for him urgently and thought his planner might be on his desk...
say:1:1621738001:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！我们不是故意翻吉罗德课本的……我们有急事找...

say:2:1621738002:1.text: You're looking for Girod? I just saw him at the <style="highlight">library</style>.
say:2:1621738002:1.source_cn: 你们要找吉罗德？我刚刚在<style=highligh...

say:3:1621738003:1.text: But he looked a bit distracted and didn't hear me say hi. He's probably stressing over the upcoming exam.
say:3:1621738003:1.source_cn: 但他好像有点心不在焉，和他打招呼他都没听见，估计是在为...

say:4:1621738004:1.text: May I ask why you're looking for Girod? I'm his friend, Urquhart. He's busy with revisions lately, but I'd be happy to help on his behalf.
say:4:1621738004:1.source_cn: 能问问你们找他有什么急事吗？我叫厄克特，是吉罗德的好朋...

say:6:1621738005:1.text: That tone... Seems like he thinks we're just some kids here to hang out with Girod... I don't like that!
say:6:1621738005:1.source_cn: 看来是被当成来找吉罗德玩的小孩子了……总觉得有点不爽！

say:7:1621738006:1.source_cn: 没办法，我们本来就是小孩子啊。

say:8:1621738007:1.text: By the way, how do you know Girod? He's never brought you up before.
say:8:1621738007:1.source_cn: 对了，你们是在哪里认识吉罗德的？他之前从没和我提过呢。

say:10:1621738008:1.text: We met him on the shopping street! A shady store owner tried to trick us, and Girod stepped in...
say:10:1621738008:1.source_cn: 是在商业街！我们差点被一个坏老板骗钱，是吉罗德帮忙……

narration:11:1621738009:1.text: The trio recounts all the details of the conflict to Urquhart…

say:12:1621738010:1.text: Wait, you mean Girod was fired?!
say:12:1621738010:1.source_cn: 等等，你们说，吉罗德被辞退了？！

say:14:1621738011:1.text: Yes... and it's all our fault. But Girod said he was already planning to quit anyway.
say:14:1621738011:1.source_cn: 是的……都怪我们太不小心了。但吉罗德还安慰我们，说他不...

say:15:1621738012:1.text: Hmm... Girod comes from a modest background, and he's been supporting himself with part-time jobs. I'm surprised he'd want to quit now after putting up with the boss for so long.
say:15:1621738012:1.source_cn: 不应该啊……吉罗德家里不富裕，一直是靠在外兼职打工才支...

say:16:1621738013:1.text: Guess Girod only said that to make us feel better...
say:16:1621738013:1.source_cn: 这么说，吉罗德当时是在……强颜欢笑？

say:18:1621738014:1.text: I'm giving all my pocket money to him!
say:18:1621738014:1.source_cn: 我还是要把自己的零花钱全都送给他！

say:19:1621738015:1.text: Relax. Maybe Girod just needs some time off from juggling studies and work.
say:19:1621738015:1.source_cn: 好了好了，别太紧张。可能吉罗德压力实在太大了，才想辞职...

say:20:1621738016:1.text: Can't believe he's started reading novels in class. He must be under a lot of stress...
say:20:1621738016:1.source_cn: 你们看，他最近压力大到都在课上看恐怖小说了。他以前可从...
